dogecoin.text:
@elonmusk Did you know #dogecoin is merge-mined with #Litecoin? You might as well work with devs on both teams. Then you’d get both a deflationary asset and a slightly inflation asset for no extra energy expenditure. Two for one. 
@LTCFoundation @SatoshiLite

@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs @loshan1212 the #LTC devs might want to weigh in seeing as the projects use the same mining infrastructure.  There is some argument to be made that the LTC+DOGE mining apparatus is one of the more environmentally friendly crypto ecosystems out there because you get 2 for 1.
